verified: Release tag resolves to the approved commit; downloaded asset matches the published digest.
Headless server starts under isolated HOME, XDG config and state directories.
Snapshots and foreground process discovery work over protected Unix sockets.
Native session metadata can be reported, but it does not prove that the foreground shell is that native session.
A cold restart rotates the socket and terminal identities while retaining reported native session metadata.
Cold restart launches claude --resume without a viewer, but the isolated client shows a login/welcome prompt. This is only launch evidence, not authenticated transcript restoration.
The plugin manifest links on the pinned runtime and exposes status/register/open actions.
The status action authenticates to the existing host connector; register returns unsupported-capability.
After isolated server restart, the startup reconciliation hook authenticates to the same host connector and retains unsupported status.
not_proven: Independent authenticated provider profiles and actual native session identity
Authenticated restoration correlated with the original transcript
Standalone and Herdr sessions sharing one connector without duplicate dispatch

verified: Installed binary hash matches the published pinned 0.9.3 Linux asset.
A separate server under owner-only temporary HOME/XDG directories passes snapshots, process observation and reconnect.
Cold restart restores the workspace. Linux reused the socket inode, but the compiled Tila socket identity changed because its timestamp fields changed.
All preexisting native process identities survived the probe. The isolated server exited and its control socket disappeared.
not_proven: Authenticated unattended native restoration with transcript correlation
Standalone and Herdr sessions sharing one connector without duplicate dispatch

credential_prerequisites.selected_accounts: Two independent Claude accounts plus plain Codex, as amended by the maintainer on 2026-10-09.
credential_prerequisites.macos: Three Tila profiles verified; both Claude native response probes passed.
credential_prerequisites.linux: Distinct Claude account metadata and both native response probes passed; Codex native daemon account read passed. No global Tila profiles were added.
credential_prerequisites.limits: Account readiness is not native session attachment or restoration.

decision: Keep integration unsupported. Status and startup reconciliation may authenticate to the existing host connector; register/open actions fail with unsupported-capability. No terminal injection or custom supervisor is introduced.
limitations: Runtime probes and fixtures cannot satisfy the live native acceptance gates. This evidence does not close issue 283.
